baseline_test_result.qualification: Last verified ordinary suite before this proposed change; rerun at implementation checkpoint.

observed_worktree_at_plan_creation.rule: Do not stage, rewrite, migrate, delete, checksum-normalize, or otherwise alter the listed user files without separate explicit authorization.

focused_test_result.scope: Provider vision, provider runtime, evidence extraction, and v4 case behaviour

offline_implementation_result.implemented_route: Nebius image conversion now uses strict multimodal Chat Completions JSON Schema; OpenAI Responses and Anthropic Messages remain unchanged.

CB-2025-0002.failure_summary: The model supplied supporting text that was not an exact substring of the canonical screenshot text; no FactResolutionResult was admitted.

documentation_result.qualification_database_policy: Retained as a local untracked audit artifact pending separate explicit authorization.

provider_validation_summary: Nebius rejected the Responses API text.format structured-output body before model inference.
The JSON-schema branch reported the required schema field as missing.
The rejected input exposed schema_ where the Nebius request validator expected schema.
The alternate ResponseFormatText branch also reported that type=json_schema was not type=text; this is a secondary union-validation consequence.
confirmed_diagnostic.established_conclusion: The image bytes were not evaluated by Qwen. The request failed at Nebius Responses API request validation, so this is a transport compatibility failure rather than an evidence, policy, prompt-reasoning, or downstream evaluation failure.
supporting_repository_evidence: CB-2025-0002 and CB-2025-0006 are the supplied cases containing PNG evidence and both failed through the current structured Responses vision route.
CB-2025-0006 persisted its product-listing PDF conversion and stopped before persisting the delivery-photo EvidenceDocument.
Nebius fact extraction already uses Chat Completions JSON Schema successfully.
OpenAI and Anthropic have distinct native adapters and are not implicated by this Nebius-specific failure.

objective.primary: Make Nebius image conversion use its working multimodal Chat Completions JSON-schema transport while preserving the existing provider-neutral VisionObservationResult and every deterministic downstream boundary.
success_path: Deterministic rendering into canonical EvidencePage text

included: Add a Chat Completions-based structured vision provider reusable by the Nebius runtime.
Wire only the Nebius runtime to the new vision provider.
Reuse the existing VisionObservationResult model, prompt, deterministic renderer, image encoding, error redaction, and execution identity contracts.
Add unit and provider-contract tests for request encoding, response parsing, validation, and failure behaviour.
Add explicitly gated live qualification for the two supplied image cases after separate approval.
Update operator documentation only after live qualification establishes the final support status.
excluded: Changes to take-home-v4 policies, facts, predicates, aggregation, recommendation mapping, or presentation rules.
Changes to CaseRun, PolicySelection, EvidenceBundle, EvidenceDocument, FactResolutionResult, evaluation, recommendation, or review-package schemas.
Changes to the native OpenAI Responses adapter.
Changes to the native Anthropic Messages adapter.
Automatic fallback from Responses to Chat Completions.
Silent repair, field renaming, fuzzy citation matching, partial admission, or retry loops.
Database migrations or modification of historical persisted runs.

non_negotiable_invariants: VisionObservationResult remains the canonical image-conversion contract.
written_text_observations, visible_pixel_observations, and limitations remain separate required structured fields.
At least one limitation remains required by strict local validation.
Visible pixels cannot establish hidden condition, absence of wobble, absence of hidden damage, complete product matching, or customer return behaviour.
The provider response remains untrusted until VisionObservationResult validates locally.
An invalid or incomplete response produces no EvidenceDocument for that image and no downstream FactResolutionResult.
No alternate provider, model, endpoint, transport, or unstructured mode is attempted automatically after failure.
The existing Nebius fact-extraction adapter remains OpenAIChatCompletionsEvidenceExtractor and is not redesigned.
OpenAI remains on native Responses and Anthropic remains on native Messages.
Provider, model, adapter, prompt version, schema version, and material parameters remain recorded without credentials.
API keys remain absent from logs, exceptions, SQLite, temporary filenames, and committed files.
Existing v4 behaviour for text-only cases remains unchanged.
Existing databases and completed results are never overwritten or migrated.

before.failure: Nebius Responses request validation rejects the structured vision text.format body before Qwen runs.

after.nebius_vision_transport: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions with multimodal content and response_format.type=json_schema

provider_neutral_flow: OpenAIChatCompletionsVisionProvider sends one admitted image and VISION_OBSERVATION_INSTRUCTIONS.
The request declares VisionObservationResult.model_json_schema() under response_format.json_schema.schema with strict=true.
The adapter retrieves exactly one assistant message containing JSON.
VisionObservationResult.model_validate_json validates the complete provider response locally.
render_vision_observations creates stable canonical page text.
The existing DocumentConverter freezes and caches the EvidenceDocument using the new provider identity.

request_contract.model: Use the exact configured MODEL_NAME without substitution.

content_blocks: A short text instruction requesting source-preserving structured observations.
One image_url data URL created from the already verified evidence file, using the existing IMAGE_DETAIL setting.

parameters.max_tokens: A fixed named constant recorded in provider identity.

prohibited_request_behaviour: Do not use responses.parse for Nebius vision.
Do not send schema_ as a wire key.
Do not omit strict structured output.
Do not include evidence from another case.
Do not send credentials inside the body or lineage.

accepted_shape.written_text_observations: Array of faithful visible writing; may be empty.
accepted_shape.visible_pixel_observations: Array of conservative visible non-text observations; may be empty.
accepted_shape.limitations: Non-empty array describing what the supplied view cannot establish.

processing: Require a choices list with at least one item.
Require a first choice containing an assistant message.
Render only after complete validation succeeds.

failure_mapping.provider_http_rejection: ProviderRejectionError or StructuredOutputUnsupportedError using the existing classifier
failure_mapping.invalid_json_or_schema: InvalidProviderResponseError with sanitised Pydantic field paths
failure_mapping.forbidden_visual_inference: InvalidProviderResponseError derived from strict local VisionObservationResult validation

response_and_validation_contract.admission_rule: No partial observations are retained. Any error aborts image conversion and prevents downstream fact admission.

execution_identity_and_cache.prompt_version: Existing VISION_PROMPT_VERSION unless the prompt itself changes during implementation review.
execution_identity_and_cache.schema_version: Existing VISION_SCHEMA_VERSION because the canonical schema semantics remain unchanged.
execution_identity_and_cache.cache_safety: Changing the adapter and structured_output identity changes converter_version, so an older Responses-generated image document cannot be mistaken for a Chat Completions conversion.
execution_identity_and_cache.secret_rule: No API key or authorization header is included in provider_version or converter_version.

file_change_plan.change: Add OpenAIChatCompletionsVisionProvider beside the existing Nebius-compatible fact extractor. Reuse shared prompt, schema, image, error, and diagnostics helpers.
Wire create_nebius_runtime to OpenAIChatCompletionsVisionProvider. Leave create_openai_runtime and create_anthropic_runtime unchanged.
Add provider-neutral semantic tests and exact Nebius Chat Completions request-body assertions, including schema rather than schema_.
Assert Nebius composes Chat Completions for both facts and vision while OpenAI and Anthropic retain their current native adapters.
Add or adjust focused unit tests for valid vision parsing, refusals, missing content, invalid JSON, forbidden inference, and secret-safe failures.
After successful live qualification only, document Nebius image support through Chat Completions and retain the honest OpenAI/Anthropic live-validation caveat.
After successful live qualification only, record the fixed transport, qualification cases, database isolation, and test results.

request_serialization: The request uses chat.completions.create rather than responses.parse.
The image is sent as a verified data URL with the admitted media type.
No schema_ key occurs in the serialized provider request.
The exact configured model is used.
response_validation: A valid three-channel response renders into stable canonical page text.
Blank or duplicate observations fail closed.
A defect-free, no-wobble, no-hidden-damage, complete-match, or return-behaviour pixel claim fails closed.
Missing choices, message, or content fails closed.
No invalid response produces a cached EvidenceDocument.
runtime_isolation: No fallback or substitution path is introduced.
security: API keys do not occur in exceptions or diagnostics.
Provider identity and converter version contain no credentials.
Raw provider output is captured only in explicit debug mode and only in a permission-restricted temporary artifact.
Normal application failures remain bounded and evidence-safe.
regression: Text-only Nebius cases retain their existing fixture-backed behaviour.
The v4 ten-case behavioural acceptance suite passes.
Existing persisted databases and rulebooks retain their checksums.

CB-2025-0002: The tracking screenshot converts through Nebius Chat Completions without StructuredOutputUnsupportedError.
Written screenshot text remains a text assertion rather than a pixel-established fact.
The complete pipeline either produces a valid review package or fails for a new, precisely reported semantic reason; transport compatibility itself must be proven.
CB-2025-0006: The delivery photograph converts through Nebius Chat Completions without StructuredOutputUnsupportedError.
The caption may be recorded only as written_text_observations.
The visible chair type, colour, and front-facing orientation may be recorded only as visible_pixel_observations.
Limitations explicitly preserve that hidden condition and non-visible properties cannot be established.
No statement claims the chair is defect-free, does not wobble, has no hidden damage, fully matches the listing, or proves customer return behaviour.
The admitted facts, deterministic requirement grades, advisory recommendation, review package, and cached reopening remain consistent with the v4 behavioural contract.
system: No provider fallback or model substitution occurs.
A failed case remains isolated and produces no partial downstream result.
The full ordinary suite passes after live qualification.

risks_and_controls.risk: Nebius Chat Completions may reject a keyword in the canonical vision schema.
risks_and_controls.control: Capture the exact 4xx error and stop. Do not silently reduce schema semantics. Any provider-facing schema adaptation requires a separate reviewed plan while retaining full local validation.

risks_and_controls.risk: Qwen may return structurally valid but semantically prohibited visual claims.
risks_and_controls.control: Existing VisionObservationResult validators reject the complete response; do not remove, rewrite, or partially admit observations.

risks_and_controls.risk: The new adapter could accidentally affect OpenAI or Anthropic.
risks_and_controls.control: Wire it only in create_nebius_runtime and assert all three runtime compositions explicitly.

risks_and_controls.risk: Old image conversions could be reused under the new transport.
risks_and_controls.control: Record a distinct adapter and structured-output parameter in provider_version so converter_version creates a separate cache key.

risks_and_controls.risk: Live qualification could alter a trusted demo database.
risks_and_controls.control: Use a new isolated database and preserve historical checksums.

risks_and_controls.risk: Detailed diagnostics could expose credentials or evidence content.
risks_and_controls.control: Retain bounded credential redaction and make raw-response capture explicit, temporary, local, and non-persisted.

rollback_plan.code: Revert the Nebius runtime wiring and the new Chat Completions vision provider as one isolated change.
rollback_plan.data: No migration rollback is required. Delete or retain the disposable qualification database according to user instruction; historical databases remain untouched.
rollback_plan.behaviour_after_rollback: Nebius image cases return to the known fail-closed StructuredOutputUnsupportedError rather than receiving altered policy outcomes.

approval_gates.authorizes: P0 through P3 only: checkpoint, code, offline tests, and regression verification.

approval_gates.name: Live Nebius image qualification approval
approval_gates.authorizes: P4 only after P3 is green; permits billable calls for CB-2025-0002 and CB-2025-0006 against a new isolated database.

approval_gates.name: Documentation and commit approval
approval_gates.authorizes: P5 documentation status changes and Git publication after results are reported.

definition_of_done: Nebius image conversion no longer uses responses.parse.
The Nebius vision request uses multimodal Chat Completions with schema under response_format.json_schema.schema.
VisionObservationResult remains unchanged and is enforced locally without partial admission.
CB-2025-0002 and CB-2025-0006 no longer fail because of the confirmed Responses schema/schema_ incompatibility.
CB-2025-0006 retains the distinction between written claims, visible pixels, and unknown hidden condition.
OpenAI and Anthropic runtime behaviour remains unchanged.
No historical database, policy, recommendation, or persisted result is modified.
The complete ordinary test suite passes.
Live results are described accurately as qualified only after G1 succeeds.
